name: Javelin
summary: Long javelin spear with a metal tip and a grip binding, shown angled up from the ground; use for throwing events.

params.name: x
params.note: x of the tip on the ground

params.name: y
params.note: ground line: the tip rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 the javelin is about 900 px long and 800 px tall at the default angle

params.name: anim
params.note: wobble = the shaft sways a little

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the javelin leans to the left
